verdict.rationale: Honeycomb ships first-party custom webhooks as a notification target for Triggers and SLO burn alerts. They deliver JSON payloads to any receiving service, and the docs cover payload templating, variables, Go template functions and example templates, so a programmatic consumer can register and receive callbacks. Event scope is limited to alert firings. missing for 10: webhook subscriptions for non-alert event types, documented delivery guarantees (retries/signing/verification), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: route notifications to Slack, PagerDuty, Microsoft Teams, or a custom webhook
This allows you to build custom integrations that receive JSON payloads from Honeycomb upon alerts firing.
Route Honeycomb Trigger and SLO burn alerts to any service that accepts a JSON payload, including third-party tools and custom integrations.
Customize Honeycomb webhook payloads with dynamic variables that populate alert context for precise, actionable notifications.
